about: Every asset Astra and her assistants made for her avatars and worlds, grouped by what it is for and its type. One copy of a finished asset lives in findastra/unity-assets-library; this list says where each one is used. Rows follow docs/asset-ledger-20261014.md (public fields only). The page's assets-we-created panel shows the same rows (test/assets-panel-test-20261019.mjs).

assets.name: Phone booth (K6)
assets.what: A handmade pink K6 kiosk with chipped enamel, lit TELEPHONE signs, gilded crowns, pink glass with fingerprints and its own payphone, with gold and pink sparkles swirling up.
assets.creator: Astra (built with Claude)
assets.attribution: Surface scans: ambientCG PaintedMetal002, Metal009, Smear002, Scratches001 (CC0)
where_used: Astra's Infinite Pole: all three phone booths (round 40, branch claude/k6-booths-20261019, not merged)
assets.library_status: in the export pull request findastra/unity-assets-library#1, not merged

assets.name: Stop 01 sunset sky
assets.what: A sunset sky dome over a 2.4 km cloud sea, with cumulus, puffs around the booth's base and a sunset reflection probe.
assets.creator: Astra (built with Claude)
